spec.name: Orange Kitchen Pulled Pork Sandwich
spec.description: A generous pulled pork sandwich with stepped sesame buns, ruffled lettuce, juicy pork strands and small melted cheese corner droops. Warm toasted colors and a bold layered silhouette keep it readable in inventory. Ground rests at y=0.

prompt: Orange SMP Kitchen cohesive premium Minecraft vanilla voxel art. Appetizing recognizable silhouette and deliberate connected pixel shading, material detail and highlights. No plain untextured cubes, random noise, letters or scenery. Use ONE well-mapped 64x64 atlas; per-face UV islands, not repeated generic material tiles. Keep texture palette cohesive: warm golden bread, fresh greens, ivory rice, rich salmon, warm ceramics. Geometry should be carefully stepped and rounded where appropriate, with purposeful tiny details. 20-55 cuboids as appropriate, stay within Java model bounds -16..32. Item ground bottom y0. Strong inventory readability. Create Pulled Pork Sandwich. Stepped rounded toasted sesame buns; distinctly ruffled lettuce and fillings layered naturally; melted cheese droops at corners. Actual recipe ingredients: bun, pulled pork, lettuce. Let the visible appearance reflect these ingredients.
